title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to enforce the MFA requirement on…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 contain a vulnerability where the multi-factor authentication (MFA) requirement is not enforced on the update and delete user API endpoints. This allows authenticated users without MFA configured to modify or delete their own accounts despite system-wide MFA enforcement being enabled.
